evidence.claim: Drass fornisce alle marine minisommergibili e soluzioni di soccorso per sottomarini, con sede a Livorno, stabilimenti in Italia e Romania e oltre 200 dipendenti.
evidence.quote: With a tradition of defence products dating back to World War II, DRASS continue to supply navies with state-of-the-art midget submarines, swimmer delivery vehicles, submarine rescue solutions || DRASS Group, headquartered in Livorno, with production facilities in Italy and Romania and commercial offices in Dubai, has over 200 direct employees operating in 13,000 sqm of covered facilities. || DRASS Group is a recognized leader in defence, commercial diving and hyperbaric solutions worldwide.
